name: Independent on Sunday cryptic crossword No 1,338

clue.text: In France, Lebanese name is conspicuous

indicators.note: the answer sits inside the run of words that follows, spanning the gap between two of them
the answer stands out in plain view among the printed letters once you look for it

blocks.note: the letters run across the end of the first word and the start of the second

explanation.surface: Someone from Lebanon living in France stands out from the crowd.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer straddles franCE LEBanese.
explanation.definitionFit: A big name is a famous person, and a celeb is the casual word for a celebrity.

clue.text: Graded fiscal side ‘uncertain’

indicators.note: letters that are uncertain have no fixed order, so the words before it are rearranged

blocks.note: the letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: A tax department's position is described as up in the air, as if in a report.
explanation.definitionFit: Something classified has been sorted into classes or grades, like hotels or listed buildings.

clue.text: For a picture of inspiration, settle on daffodil?

blocks.note: to light on something is to settle or land on it
a daffodil grows from a bulb; the question mark admits it is an example

explanation.surface: An artist hunting for an image to stand for inspiration might choose a daffodil, as Wordsworth did.
explanation.walkthrough: The daffodil nods to Wordsworth's poem, but here it is just a plant grown from a bulb.
explanation.definitionFit: Cartoonists draw a glowing bulb over a character's head to show a sudden bright idea.

clue.text: Fire-holder is less rational, caught going for book

indicators.note: one letter goes in place of another, the first named taking the position of the second

blocks.note: less rational means more crazy
C is the cricket scorecard abbreviation for caught
B is the abbreviation for book

explanation.surface: Someone tending a fire is becoming unhinged.
explanation.walkthrough: Swap the C at the front of CRAZIER for B.
explanation.definitionFit: A brazier is a metal basket or stand that holds burning coals outdoors.

clue.text: Site manager brews up with mate

indicators.note: things that are stirred up are thrown into disorder, so the letters get rearranged

blocks.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A foreman on a building site makes tea with a colleague.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Site manager' suggests a building site; it is a website.
explanation.definitionFit: A webmaster is the person who runs and maintains a website.

clue.text: Twist connections, severing one

indicators.note: severing cuts something off, so a letter is removed from the word before it

blocks.note: electrical connections are the wiring
the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Someone twists the wires, cutting one of them.
explanation.walkthrough: Take the first I out of WIRING.
explanation.definitionFit: To wring something is to twist it hard, as when squeezing water from a cloth.

clue.text: Lad right in buff with lover

indicators.note: one element is placed inside the other word

blocks.note: a lad is a boy
R is the abbreviation for right
a buff or enthusiast is a fiend, as in a fitness fiend

explanation.surface: A young man is in the nude alongside his sweetheart.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In buff' suggests naked, but buff means an enthusiast here, and 'in' is the insertion signal.
explanation.definitionFit: A boyfriend is a man in a romantic relationship, someone's male lover.

clue.text: A queen has a short moment as a fish?

indicators.note: something cut short loses its end, so the last letter is dropped

blocks.note: taken as written
QU is an abbreviation for queen
taken as written
a tick is a moment, as in 'just a tick'

explanation.surface: A monarch briefly takes on the role of a fish, as in a pantomime.
explanation.definitionFit: Fish live in water, and aquatic describes creatures that live in water; the question mark marks the example.

clue.text: Verily Thy reign hath no end where Earth’s last vestige hath fled away

indicators.note: a word with no end has lost its final letter
the last trace of a word is its final letter
the shortened word fills the very place a letter has vacated, standing in for it
a letter that has fled leaves an empty slot for the other piece to fill

blocks.note: taken as written
to reign is to rule
the final letter of the word earth

explanation.surface: A biblical-sounding prophecy that a reign will last forever once the earth has passed away.
explanation.walkthrough: Take the H out of THY and put the curtailed RUL in its place. The mock-scriptural language suits the archaic definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Verily is an archaic word for truly or in truth, familiar from the King James Bible.

clue.text: Said to cause a stink

indicators.note: said means spoken, so the word is taken by its sound rather than its spelling

blocks.note: to wreak havoc is to cause it

explanation.surface: A rumour that someone has been stirring up trouble.
explanation.definitionFit: A reek is a strong unpleasant smell, so it is a noun meaning a bad stench.

clue.text: Cruelly hang, if a person in Kabul’s ready

indicators.note: treating something cruelly mangles it, so the following letters are rearranged

blocks.note: the letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone in Kabul is prepared to be executed harshly.
explanation.walkthrough: Ready is slang for cash. The afghani is the currency of Afghanistan, whose capital is Kabul.
explanation.definitionFit: The Afghan's money is the afghani, the national currency of Afghanistan, ready being slang for cash.

clue.text: Solver’s beginning to emigrate? Butt in: ‘I’ll look after your videos’

indicators.note: the beginning of a word is its first letter
the item is pushed inside the letters already assembled

blocks.note: the solver is you, the person reading
a butt is a large cask or tub
the first letter of emigrate

explanation.surface: A solver thinks of emigrating, then someone butts in offering to look after their video collection.
explanation.walkthrough: A butt is a large barrel for water or wine; the question mark covers the jokey surface.
explanation.definitionFit: YouTube is the website that stores and shares the videos people upload to it.

clue.text: In police trap, the object’s fairly well placed

indicators.note: one element goes inside the other, as something caught in a trap

blocks.note: a sting is a police operation to trap criminals
it is the object pronoun
pretty means fairly, as in pretty good

explanation.surface: Something caught in a police operation is fairly well located.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The object' is grammar: it is the object pronoun, not a thing.
explanation.definitionFit: Sitting pretty is an idiom for being in a comfortable, advantageous position.

clue.text: Built us a true ark or dish

indicators.note: building puts materials together into a new form, so the following letters are rearranged

blocks.note: the letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone like Noah constructed a proper ark, or perhaps a meal, for the crew.
explanation.definitionFit: Sauerkraut is a German side dish of finely shredded fermented cabbage.

clue.text: Glow in the dark or escape through chimney

indicators.note: passing through something puts you inside it, so the items go within the next word

blocks.note: taken as written
Esc is the escape key on a keyboard
a flue is the duct of a chimney

explanation.surface: A choice between glowing in the dark or escaping up the chimney, like a ghost or Santa.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Escape' gives the abbreviation on the computer key, not a synonym.
explanation.definitionFit: To fluoresce is to emit visible light after absorbing radiation, as glowing paint or minerals do.

clue.text: Ready for the main other ways on journey

indicators.note: things on a journey are on the move, so the letters are moved into a new order

blocks.note: the letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone prepared for the main course takes a different route.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The main' is a poetic term for the open sea.
explanation.definitionFit: A seaworthy vessel is fit and safe to sail on the open ocean, the main.

clue.text: Drink two halves of Coke with dash of Angostura

indicators.note: a dash is a tiny amount, so only the first letter of the word is used

blocks.note: the first half of coke, CO, taken twice
the first letter of Angostura

explanation.surface: A bartender's cocktail: two half-measures of cola with a splash of bitters.
explanation.walkthrough: Angostura is a brand of cocktail bitters.
explanation.definitionFit: Cocoa is a hot chocolate drink made from powdered cacao beans and milk.

clue.text: Dodging and dashing a north-easterly line

blocks.note: dashing means stylish, chic
taken as written
NE is the compass abbreviation for north-east
RY is the abbreviation for railway, a line

explanation.surface: Someone darting and weaving along a railway heading north-east.
explanation.definitionFit: Dodging here means trickery and evasion, and chicanery is deceitful underhand behaviour.

clue.text: Drug doctor’s given journalist for fix

blocks.note: E is slang for the drug ecstasy
MB is a medical degree, Bachelor of Medicine
ED is short for editor

explanation.surface: A doctor gives a drug to a reporter looking for a fix.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fix' suggests a drug dose; it is the verb meaning to set firmly.
explanation.definitionFit: To embed something is to fix it firmly in a surrounding mass.

clue.text: Figure there’s a month before the start of November

indicators.note: the start of a word is its first letter

blocks.note: Dec is the abbreviation for December
ago means before now, in the past
the first letter of November

explanation.surface: Someone counts the days in a month leading up to November.
explanation.definitionFit: A decagon is a geometrical figure, a polygon with ten sides.

clue.text: Perhaps flavouring containing cocaine is very moreish

indicators.note: the first item holds the second inside it

blocks.note: a flavouring is one example of a food additive
C is slang for cocaine

explanation.surface: A food flavouring laced with cocaine makes a snack hard to stop eating.
explanation.definitionFit: Moreish food makes you want more, and addictive food is hard to stop consuming.

clue.text: Purge families around eastern Spain

indicators.note: one item wraps around the other

blocks.note: clans are extended families
E is the abbreviation for eastern
E is the international vehicle code for Spain

explanation.surface: A historical purge of clans across eastern Spain.
explanation.walkthrough: CLANS goes around E, then E for Spain follows.
explanation.definitionFit: To cleanse is to rid something of impurities, the same idea as purging it clean.

clue.text: Strutting fellow motivating few to hack lock

indicators.note: motivating sets things in motion, so the letters are moved about

blocks.note: the letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: A swaggering burglar inspires a small gang to break a lock.
explanation.definitionFit: A cock of the walk is a domineering, swaggering man who acts as the boss of a group.

clue.text: She doubts motives shown when niceness follows intimacy

indicators.note: the first-named word is to be written after the second, reversing the printed order
only the stretch on view where the two words meet is kept, the rest of each word dropped

blocks.note: taken as written, placed first
taken as written, placed second

explanation.surface: A wary woman suspects ulterior motives when kindness comes after closeness.
explanation.walkthrough: Put niceness after intimacy and the answer straddles intimaCY NICeness.
explanation.definitionFit: A cynic believes people act only from self-interest and so distrusts their motives.

clue.text: Note girl taking a shy

indicators.note: taking something away removes it, so a letter comes out of the word before

blocks.note: ti is a note of the sol-fa scale
a maid is an old word for a girl
taken as written

explanation.surface: A girl takes a nervous note.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Taking a' looks like adding; here it takes the A out of MAID.
explanation.definitionFit: Timid and shy both describe someone lacking confidence and easily frightened.

clue.text: Want to throw piano away

indicators.note: something sent away is gone, so the letter is removed

blocks.note: to pitch is to throw
P is the musical abbreviation for piano, softly

explanation.surface: Someone longs to hurl a piano out of the room.
explanation.definitionFit: An itch is a restless craving, as in an itch to travel, so it is a want.

clue.text: Performing in fast Broadway song

indicators.note: one item placed inside the other

blocks.note: a performer on stage is on
fast as in held fast, firmly fixed, tight

explanation.surface: Appearing in a quick number on Broadway.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fast' suggests speed; here it means firmly secured.
explanation.definitionFit: Tonight is a famous song from the Broadway musical West Side Story.

clue.text: E.g. Horatio de la Nelson?

blocks.note: Horatio is a man's name, so he is an example of a man
taken as written

explanation.surface: A mock-aristocratic version of Admiral Horatio Nelson's name.
explanation.walkthrough: The admiral is a false lead: the Nelson wanted is the South African president Nelson Mandela, and the question mark flags him as one example.
explanation.definitionFit: Nelson Mandela was the anti-apartheid leader who became South Africa's first black president; Nelson is his first name.

clue.text: Knight on horse looked tired

indicators.note: in an across clue, one thing on another comes after it, so the first-named piece goes second

blocks.note: a hack is a horse for ordinary riding
N is the chess notation for knight
to eye something is to look at it

explanation.surface: A knight on horseback looked exhausted.
explanation.walkthrough: In an across clue, 'on' means after, so N follows HACK.
explanation.definitionFit: Hackneyed means overused and stale, and tired here means trite rather than weary.

clue.text: Grief amidst alien land

indicators.note: something amidst another lies in the middle of it

blocks.note: gyp is British slang for pain or trouble, as in 'giving me gyp'
ET is the film alien, extraterrestrial

explanation.surface: Sorrow among extraterrestrials on a strange planet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Alien land' reads as one phrase; alien gives ET and land alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Egypt is a country in north-east Africa, and a country is a land.
